description: CreateNote adds a note and returns it with its id.

state.description: state closes ("done") or reopens ("open") the note when set.

title.description: title replaces the title when set.

name: chat_interrupt

name: chat_respond

timeout.description: Unset defaults to ten minutes. Zero waits until cancellation.

node.description: node is a node name, or (owner only) a path.Match glob over node names.

task.description: task says what the grant is for, e.g. "update the kids' machine". It is stored with the token and written to every audit line the grant causes.

name: hub_get_sleeve_runtime

description: GetStatus returns the hub version, host platform and uptime.
name: hub_get_status

description: CancelJob stops a job and its whole process tree, named by id or by the SubmitJob request_id. Cancelling a finished job is a no-op that returns its record.

id.description: id names the job. Set exactly one of id and request_id.

requestId.description: request_id names the job by the SubmitJob key, for a caller that never saw the response. A submit still in flight is awaited and then canceled. When no submit with the key has reached the hub, the key is remembered as canceled for 1h so a late submit is refused (aborted), and the call fails with not_found.

name: job_cancel_job

description: GetJob returns one job record.
name: job_get_job

description: ListJobs returns job records, newest first.

limit.description: limit caps the result; zero means 50.

state.description: state, when set, keeps only jobs in that state.

name: job_list_jobs

description: SubmitJob queues a job and returns at once with its id. Follow it with WatchJob.

admin.description: admin runs the command elevated (sudo -n on Linux, the agent's own elevated token on Windows). It needs a named node or a lease (not a selector), a node that reports it can elevate, and the owner token or a node_admin grant for the node. Admin jobs are never sandboxed.

artifactGlobs.description: artifact_globs select files, relative to the working directory, that are sent back to $PROTECTORATE_HOME/jobs/<id>/artifacts/. A glob that matches a directory takes the files below it.

command.description: command is the argv to execute; argv[0] is resolved on the node, relative to the working directory when it contains a path separator.

limits.description: limits cap a sandboxed job (JOB_MODE_SANDBOXED on a node whose sandbox is "bwrap" or a Windows job object); unset means no cap.

cpuPercent.description: cpu_percent is CPU time as a share of one core: 200 is two cores.

memoryBytes.description: memory_bytes caps resident memory, at least 64 MiB; no swap on Linux.

requestId.description: request_id is a client-chosen idempotency key, 8 to 128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9._-]. The hub remembers it for 1h after the first submit with it: a repeat returns the same job instead of creating another, and waits if the first call is still in flight. Pick it with enough entropy to be unique among callers (a UUID or 16 random bytes in hex). With it, a caller that lost the response can still find or cancel the job (CancelJob request_id). Empty means no deduplication.

artifact.description: artifact runs in a fresh job directory holding the file.

path.description: path is a file or directory on the hub.

workdir.description: workdir is the directory, relative to the job directory, the command runs in; empty means the job directory itself. Directories only.

git.description: git checks the commit out in a per-repo worktree on the node that is reused by later jobs, so build caches stay warm.

commit.description: commit is any revision the repository resolves; empty means HEAD. The job record holds the full id.

repo.description: repo is a path to a git repository on the hub.

leaseId.description: lease_id runs on the node of a live lease (and on its GPU, if any).

selector.description: selector picks the least-loaded fresh matching node of tier "shared" that is not leased.

gpu.description: gpu requires a GPU whose vendor or name contains this text, ignoring case (e.g. "adreno", "intel"); with gpu_vram_bytes the reserved GPU must match it too.

gpuVramBytes.description: gpu_vram_bytes asks for one GPU with at least this much free VRAM; a lease then reserves that GPU instead of the whole node.

minFreeMemoryBytes.description: min_free_memory_bytes is the least available memory the node must report.

npu.description: npu requires an NPU whose vendor or name contains this text, ignoring case (e.g. "hexagon").

os.description: os and arch are Go GOOS/GOARCH values such as "windows" and "arm64".

timeout.description: timeout bounds the command's run time; zero means 1h, at most 24h.

name: job_submit_job

description: AcquireLease reserves one resource exclusively: a node name ("win1"), one GPU ("gpu-box:gpu1") or whatever a selector picks. A selector chooses the least-loaded fresh matching node of tier "shared" that is not already leased; nodes of tier "care" are never leased. When the resource is held, the call fails with failed_precondition, unless the request sets wait: then the caller is queued first in first out (highest priority first) and gets a ticket, a Lease in state QUEUED. When the hub grants a ticket it holds the lease for the waiter for a short claim window and sends it a notice message; RenewLease with no ttl claims the lease for the requested ttl, otherwise it passes to the next waiter. ReleaseLease on a ticket leaves the queue.

holder.description: holder labels who holds the lease, e.g. a sleeve or agent name.

priority.description: priority orders the queue: larger first, then first come first served.

resource.description: resource is a node name or "<node>:gpu<index>".

gpu.description: gpu requires a GPU whose vendor or name contains this text, ignoring case (e.g. "adreno", "intel"); with gpu_vram_bytes the reserved GPU must match it too.

gpuVramBytes.description: gpu_vram_bytes asks for one GPU with at least this much free VRAM; a lease then reserves that GPU instead of the whole node.

minFreeMemoryBytes.description: min_free_memory_bytes is the least available memory the node must report.

npu.description: npu requires an NPU whose vendor or name contains this text, ignoring case (e.g. "hexagon").

os.description: os and arch are Go GOOS/GOARCH values such as "windows" and "arm64".

ttl.description: ttl is how long the lease lives without a renewal; at most 24h.

wait.description: wait queues the caller when the resource is held instead of failing.

name: lease_acquire_lease

description: ListLeases returns every live lease, then every queued ticket.
name: lease_list_leases

description: ReleaseLease frees a lease at once. Releasing an unknown or expired lease is an error.
name: lease_release_lease

description: RenewLease pushes the expiry of a live lease to now plus a TTL.

ttl.description: ttl replaces the lease's TTL; zero keeps the current one.

name: lease_renew_lease

description: Ack confirms a message. It stops the ack timer.

as.description: as acks on behalf of a recipient; only the owner may.

unreadOnly.description: unread_only leaves out messages already injected, shown or acked.

limit.description: limit is the most threads returned: 0 means 100, at most 500.

project.description: project keeps the threads addressed to or sent from this project (id, "owner/repo" or bare name, as in DirectoryService.GetProject).

sleeve.description: sleeve keeps the threads this sleeve sent to or received in.

name: message_list_threads

description: Reply answers a message in the same thread, addressed to its sender, and acks the original.
name: message_reply

description: Send addresses a message to a sleeve name, "project:<id-or-name>", "orchestrator" or "owner". Retrying with the same request_id returns the original message instead of sending twice.

ackRequired.description: ack_required starts the ack timer. Unset, a request asks for an ack and other kinds do not; set false, even a request asks for none.

requestId.description: request_id (8-128 chars) makes a retry return the original message.

threadId.description: thread_id continues an existing thread; empty starts a new one.

to.description: to is a sleeve name, "project:<id-or-name>", "orchestrator" or "owner".

name: message_send

description: Thread returns every message of a thread in the order sent.
name: message_thread

timeout.description: Default 10 minutes; positive and at most 24 hours.

description: GetNode returns one node with full metrics: filesystems, GPUs, containers, engine disk usage and watched directories.
name: node_get_node

description: ListNodes returns every node with its latest metrics summary, freshness and alerts.
name: node_list_nodes

description: PutFile copies a file or directory to a node, one chunk per call so it works over plain HTTP/1.1. A transfer is a sequence of calls sharing a transfer_id with consecutive offsets; the call with last set carries the size and SHA-256 of the whole (uncompressed) stream, and only then is the destination replaced, atomically. The hub relays chunks without storing them. The remote path is confined to the node's file root unless the node agent was started unconfined.

rawSize.description: raw_size is the length after decompression.

last.description: last ends the transfer; trailer is then required.

mode.description: mode holds the permission bits of a file; ignored for directories.

offset.description: offset is the number of uncompressed bytes sent in earlier calls.

overwrite.description: overwrite replaces an existing destination instead of failing with ALREADY_EXISTS.

path.description: path, kind, mode and overwrite are read on the first call (offset 0). A relative path is under the node's file root; the path names the destination itself, not a directory to put it in.

size.description: size and sha256 (hex) cover the uncompressed stream.

skipped.description: skipped counts directory entries that were not sent (symlinks, devices).

transferId.description: transfer_id is chosen by the caller: 8 to 80 characters of [A-Za-z0-9._-].

name: node_put_file

description: GetQuota returns the usage windows, resets and freshness of every provider subscription (Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity, local LLMs).

refresh.description: refresh forces an immediate read of each provider, rate-limited per provider; providers read too recently keep their cached data.

name: quota_get_quota

description: Suggest ranks the harnesses a sleeve can run (claude, codex, grok and pi) by usable spare capacity before reset, best first. Only FRESH quota data counts as capacity: STALE and UNKNOWN providers are listed as not recommended. A harness scores the capacity that is usable now (the tightest window) and expected to expire unused at a reset, weighted toward the sooner reset. pi on the local LLM has no quota and is always recommended as the fallback, ranked below any subscription with real capacity to burn. Antigravity has no sleeve harness and is not listed.

refresh.description: refresh forces an immediate quota read first, as in GetQuotaRequest.

taskSize.description: task_size is a hint for how much headroom the work needs; a harness with less usable capacity than that is not recommended. Unset means medium.

name: quota_suggest

description: CapturePane returns the current text of a session's active pane. It also works on exited sessions, which is how a crash is diagnosed. Include at least one history line to see the whole final screen of an exited session.

lines.description: Number of history lines above the visible screen to include. Values above 10000 are clamped to 10000.

name.description: name of the session to read.

name: session_capture_pane

description: KillSession terminates a session and every process in it. It also removes an exited session, discarding its final screen.

name.description: name of the session to kill.

name: session_kill_session

description: ListSessions returns all sessions, running and exited.
name: session_list_sessions

description: BrowseWorkspaces lists configured roots when path is empty, otherwise subdirectories of path. Resolved paths must stay inside a configured root. Sleeve identity tokens cannot call this RPC, even with read scope.
name: sleeve_browse_workspaces

description: CreateCheckpoint snapshots the sleeve's git workspace: tracked files and untracked files that are not ignored. The hub also checkpoints a chat sleeve when a turn settles and before a resleeve. Checkpoints live in a private store under the hub's state, never in the workspace repository, so no push can carry them; the newest 20 are kept. If nothing changed since the latest checkpoint, that checkpoint is returned with unchanged.
name: sleeve_create_checkpoint

description: DiffCheckpoint returns a unified diff from checkpoint from_id to checkpoint to_id, or to the current workspace when to_id is 0. Output beyond 1 MiB is cut off and marked truncated.
name: sleeve_diff_checkpoint

description: GetSleeve returns one sleeve with its latest resource usage.
name: sleeve_get_sleeve

description: KillSleeve stops a sleeve's harness and every process in its sandbox and retains its exited record. The workspace and the sleeve's home directory are kept on disk unless drop_caches removes regenerable caches.

dropCaches.description: Owner only: remove regenerable home caches after stopping the sleeve.

name: sleeve_kill_sleeve

description: ListCheckpoints returns the sleeve's checkpoints, oldest first.
name: sleeve_list_checkpoints

description: ListSleeves returns every known sleeve, running or exited, with its latest resource usage.
name: sleeve_list_sleeves

description: ListWorkspaces returns the directories SpawnSleeve would accept as an existing workspace: git checkouts and other directories under the hub's workspaces directory (cloned or created by earlier sleeves), and the workspaces of known sleeves elsewhere on disk. Read-only reference entries are also returned with read_only set. It never walks the rest of the filesystem; any other absolute path can still be given to SpawnSleeve directly.
name: sleeve_list_workspaces

description: ResleeveSleeve moves a chat sleeve to another harness on the same workspace, under the same name, without asking the outgoing harness anything. The hub takes the chat over (no other sender can start a turn), waits for it to be IDLE (interrupting a turn that runs past wait), composes facts in code (git status, diff --stat, recent commits, backlog and mail, the last user messages and the final assistant message from the outgoing harness's own transcript), has a separate model write a Goal/State/Unfinished/Next/Gotchas summary (the subscription with the most spare quota other than the outgoing harness, else pi with the local LLM), overwrites <workspace>/.protectorate/HANDOFF.md (kept out of git through .git/info/exclude, archived under the hub's state directory), replaces the harness and sends it one plain user message naming the handoff. The summary runs while the outgoing turn winds down. The old native session stays on disk for a later resume. If the new harness cannot start, the old one is respawned on its own session. Announced as "sleeve.resleeved"; a summary by the fallback model, or none, also emits "resleeve.warning".

interrupt.description: interrupt cancels a running turn at once instead of waiting for it.

nativeDefaults.description: Explicitly discard the outgoing selection when switching harnesses.

effort.description: Native effort value, validated against the selected model's catalog.

to.description: to is the new harness. UNSPECIFIED means auto: the top recommendation of QuotaService.Suggest other than the current harness.

wait.description: wait bounds how long a running turn may continue before it is interrupted. Default 5 minutes.

name: sleeve_resleeve_sleeve

description: RestoreCheckpoint makes the workspace's non-ignored files match a checkpoint, removing files the checkpoint lacks. Ignored files, the workspace's .git directory and its index are untouched. It first checkpoints the current state, returned as before, so a restore can be undone. A chat sleeve must be idle.
name: sleeve_restore_checkpoint

description: SpawnSleeve starts a harness in a new isolated sleeve on the hub. The workspace is an existing directory (bound read-write at the same path) or a git URL cloned into the hub's workspaces directory. Branch options clone local checkouts too; brief is delivered as the first chat message. Respawning the name of an exited sleeve reuses its home directory and workspace and replaces its kept session.

args.description: args are extra arguments for the harness, or the whole command for shell.

branch.description: Branch to clone; local sources default to their current branch.

brief.description: First chat message, delivered before spawn succeeds. Chat mode only.

env.description: env holds extra environment variables for the harness.

exitAfterIdle.description: Zero disables automatic removal. Applies only to chat sleeves.

cpuPercent.description: cpu_percent caps CPU time; 100 is one core, 200 two cores. 0 means unlimited.

diskBytes.description: disk_bytes bounds the sleeve's workspace, home, cache overlays and checkpoint store, as the hub samples them every 10 seconds while it runs. At 90% the hub emits "sleeve.disk_warning"; at 100% it stops the harness, emits "sleeve.disk_limit", notes it in the chat and audits it. Writes between samples are not blocked. 0 means unlimited.

memoryBytes.description: memory_bytes caps memory including page cache and tmpfs; swap is disabled when set. 0 means unlimited.

name.description: name is 1-40 of a-z 0-9 and '-', starting with a letter or digit.

nested.description: Delegates a private cgroup subtree; requires CPU and memory limits.

newBranch.description: Create and check out this branch from branch in a fresh clone.

selection.description: Codex chat selection; omitted effort uses the hub's sleeve effort default. Other drivers reject explicit selection.

effort.description: Native effort value, validated against the selected model's catalog.

supervised.description: supervised runs a chat sleeve's harness in its asking permission mode instead of autonomous: Claude --permission-mode default, Codex approvalPolicy untrusted with its workspace-write sandbox, Grok /always-approve off. pi has no gate and ignores it.

workspace.description: workspace is an absolute directory path on the hub, or a git URL to clone.

name: sleeve_spawn_sleeve

description: GetStatus returns the hub's tailnet identity and every peer it knows. FAILED_PRECONDITION when the tailnet is not enabled on this hub.
name: tailnet_get_status
